name: Anbernic RG35XX Plus / RG35XX SP
identify: helperFunctions.sh: cpuinfo CPU part "*0xd03*" (H700) -> reads BASEOS_TARGET from /etc/baseos-release; case "rg35xxplus"|"rg35xxsp" -> PLATFORM=AnbernicXX640480NoStick

pad.note: A/B/X/Y, L1/R1, digital L2/R2, SELECT/START, MENU (plus its KEY_GOTO tap pulse), D-pad hat, stick axes, FF rumble and, on the RG35XX Plus and RG35XX SP, the volume keys (measured 2026-11-12), all on one event1 node (also js0)

vol.note: vendor's own typo for the node name, kept verbatim. It declares 114/115, but on the RG35XX Plus and RG35XX SP nothing fired on it (2026-11-12); other models of the line send the volume keys here (NextUI port, controller-matrix event2 entry)

lid-sensor.from: cfg (LID_STATUS_PATH, LID_CLOSED_VALUE in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg); matrix (lid_watchdog_v2.sh runs only on *sp BASEOS_TARGETs)
lid-sensor.note: sysfs poll, not an evdev switch; LID_CLOSED_VALUE=0

VOL_UP.note: on the RG35XX Plus and RG35XX SP the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys and nothing on dierct-keys-polled. The NextUI port saw the RG34XX SP and RG40XX V use dierct-keys-polled under other firmware; the RG34XX SP on BaseOS 1.4.0 uses ANBERNIC-keys too (2026-11-12)

VOL_DOWN.note: on the RG35XX Plus and RG35XX SP the key arrives on ANBERNIC-keys and nothing on dierct-keys-polled. The NextUI port saw the RG34XX SP and RG40XX V use dierct-keys-polled under other firmware; the RG34XX SP on BaseOS 1.4.0 uses ANBERNIC-keys too (2026-11-12)

absent.L3: no analog stick on this bucket's hardware; cfg still exports B_L3="1 313" (shared AnbernicXXCommon.cfg), but the nostick SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_MAP (_XX_GC_NOSTICK) binds no button there (derived from AnbernicXXCommon.cfg + controller-matrix idx table).
absent.R3: no analog stick on this bucket's hardware; cfg still exports B_R3="1 316" (shared AnbernicXXCommon.cfg), but the nostick SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_MAP (_XX_GC_NOSTICK) binds no button there (derived from AnbernicXXCommon.cfg + controller-matrix idx table).
absent.LEFT_STICK: 0 sticks on this bucket (XX_PAD_LAYOUT="nostick" -> DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0 in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg)
absent.RIGHT_STICK: 0 sticks on this bucket (XX_PAD_LAYOUT="nostick" -> DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0 in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg)
absent.HOME: cfg B_HOME="DOESNT_EXIST"; MENU is spruce's home key on this line (matrix)
absent.FN_SWITCH: no latching Fn switch on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_LEFT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)
absent.FN_RIGHT: no Fn keys distinct from L3/R3 on the Anbernic XX line; cfg exports none (matrix)

notes: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME is computed at runtime; rg35xxplus has its own arm: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME="Anbernic RG35XX Plus". rg35xxsp is NOT one of the named arms (only rgcubexx/rgsp/rg35xxplus/rg35xxh/rg35xxpro/rg40xxh/rg40xxv are), so it falls to the default arm: SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME="Anbernic RG35XXSP" (upper-cased BASEOS_TARGET, no space) -- note the mismatch against this file's model name "RG35XX SP" (with a space); a Button Reader name match that requires an exact substring will miss it.

VOL_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/POWER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH/CONTROLLER_KEY_WATCHER_PATH are exported in AnbernicXXCommon.cfg (event0/event2/event1) but nothing in the h700 tree reads them -- dead variables, not evidence for any control's source (grep of spruce/scripts at spruce_ref 0dccf5276b).

LID is only on RG35XX SP, not RG35XX Plus (controller-matrix models.rg35xxsp/.rg35xxplus; lid_watchdog_v2.sh only runs for *sp BASEOS_TARGETs) -- scoped with the new "models" key on the LID control instead of a note.
models are spruce's own SPRUCE_DEVICE_NAME values (AnbernicXXCommon.cfg); Button Reader matches the unit's name against them
